content: In Hosea, what does God desire rather than sacrifice?
explanation: Jesus quoted this verse. “For I desire mercy, not sacrifice” (Hosea 6:6, BSB)

content: In Hosea, out of which land did God call His son Israel?
explanation: God loved Israel as a child. “When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.” (Hosea 11:1, BSB)

content: In Hosea, what does the prophet urge Israel to do?
explanation: They had stumbled by sin. “Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God” (Hosea 14:1, BSB)

content: In Hosea, God says He led Israel with ropes of what?
explanation: And cords of kindness. “I led them with cords of kindness, with ropes of love” (Hosea 11:4, BSB)

content: Whom did the prophet Hosea marry?
explanation: His marriage pictured God and Israel. “So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim” (Hosea 1:3, BSB)

content: In Hosea, God told Hosea to love his wife again as the LORD loves whom?
explanation: God's love is faithful. “Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites” (Hosea 3:1, BSB)

content: In Hosea, God desires the knowledge of God rather than what?
explanation: He wants hearts, not rituals. “and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.” (Hosea 6:6, BSB)

content: In Hosea, what did God lift from His people's necks?
explanation: He bent down to feed them. “I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down to feed them.” (Hosea 11:4, BSB)

content: Who was the prophet Hosea's father?
explanation: Hosea prophesied in Uzziah's days. “the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri” (Hosea 1:1, BSB)

content: In Hosea, Gomer was the daughter of whom?
explanation: She bore Hosea a son. “So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim” (Hosea 1:3, BSB)
